title: Now Let Our Prayers Ascend to Thee
description: Now Let Our Prayers Ascend to Thee in Tonic Solfa to YORK, doh is F: the solfa with the words, staff notation, 4 verses and a piano.
about: These words were printed without an author's name in Hymns for Christian Devotion, compiled by John G. Adams and Edwin H. Chapin (Boston, 1846), as hymn 870 of its twenty-second edition (1853), “The Same”.
The book printed the words without tunes, marked Common Metre (8.6.8.6), to be sung to any tune of that metre. This page sets them to YORK; any other Common Metre tune fits them as well.
underlay: Now let our prayers as-cend to thee, Thou great and ho-ly One; A-bove the world raise thou our hearts; In us, thy will be done.

lines: Now let our prayers ascend to thee,
Above the world raise thou our hearts;
In us, thy will be done.
O, let us feel how frail we are,
How much we need thy grace;
O, strengthen, Lord, our fainting souls,
While here we seek thy face.
Our sins, alas! before thee rise;
Let not our faith, our hope, our trust,
Forgive our sins, thy spirit grant,
And heavenly peace and holy hope
